question.problem: Let $A$ be a $7\times 5$ matrix. What is the image of ${R}^{5}$ under the action of $A?$
question.worked_solution:
Pre-multiplying a vector $x\in {R}^{5}$ by $A$ gives a linear combination of the columns of $A:$

$$
{{[\begin{aligned}| & | & | & | & | \\ {a}_{1} & {a}_{2} & {a}_{3} & {a}_{4} & {a}_{5} \\ | & | & | & | & |\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3} \\ {x}_{4} \\ {x}_{5}\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{x}={x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}| \\ {a}_{1} \\ |\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}| \\ {a}_{2} \\ |\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}| \\ {a}_{3} \\ |\end{aligned}]+{x}_{4}[\begin{aligned}| \\ {a}_{4} \\ |\end{aligned}]+{x}_{5}[\begin{aligned}| \\ {a}_{5} \\ |\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, the image of ${R}^{5}$ under the action of $A$ must be $\text{Col}(A),$ the column space of $A.$
